entries.title: Crewmates start with your project's own instructions and skills
entries.body: Every crewmate now starts its work with your project's AGENTS.md (or its CLAUDE.md) already in hand, and with the skills your project keeps in .claude/skills or .agents/skills listed for it. Before, a crewmate had to open AGENTS.md itself, and saw a skill only when AGENTS.md named it. Nothing from folders outside your project, and none of your own Claude setup, comes with them.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the change is in what a crewmate starts its work with.
